thread:
Mike (Support): Escalating — GlintAI onboarding blocked: SSO token exchange failing with 403 during provisioning. Customer is in onboarding runbook, renewal in ~6 weeks. Need CS lead + enablement touch today. Error below and repro steps. OpsBot already opened incident: https://redwood.incidents/INC-7890 :exclamation:

Anna (CS): @Mike thanks for the heads up. Can you paste the minimal repro and confirm if this is repro on staging or only prod? Also who is the primary contact at Glint? :eyes:

Mike (Support): Repro is on prod and staging. Primary contact is Maya from Glint (maya@glint.ai). Short repro:
```
1) Create tenant with SAML metadata payload
2) Trigger /provision with embed scope
3) Token exchange returns 403 from identity service: "invalid_audience"
```
We see ~20% of customer users failing to provision during first run. Sample logs: "auth: token validation failed - aud mismatch".

Anna (CS): Ok — priority = P0 for CS handoff. Proposed comms plan: 1) Immediate one-pager to Glint with visible ETA and mitigation, 2) Internal owner for technical fix, 3) Short enablement session (30m) to walk customer through temporary manual provisioning. Who can own the technical side?

Jai (Solutions Eng): I can take lead on triage and quick patch today. I'll run a token-audience mapping check and confirm if it's an upstream config mismatch or a header normalization bug. ETA 3 hours for initial root-cause. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Emily CSM: I'll own the customer comm and enablement. Draft message I'll send to Maya: "We’re investigating a provisioning issue causing SSO token rejections for some users. We’ll run a short manual provisioning flow for impacted users while engineering works on a fix. ETA initial triage update in 3 hours; final rollback or patch within 24 hours." Will @Mike send the list of impacted user emails and any session IDs?

Mike (Support): Sending list now in DM. Also included screenshot of failed provisioning step. :thumbsup:

Anna (CS): Internal tasks — Jai to triage & patch (owner), Emily to run immediate enablement play and customer-facing message (owner), Mike to supply logs and impacted user list (owner). I'll coordinate postmortem and renewal risk flag in CRM. Quick checklist for the comms one-pager (Emily):
- What happened (1-2 lines)
- Who is impacted (scope)
- Short workaround (manual provisioning) + steps
- ETA for next update and final resolution window
- Contact and escalation path (CS + SE on call)

Emily CSM: Draft copy attached below, feel free to edit: 
```
Subject: Quick update on provisioning issue
Hi Maya —
We’re actively investigating an issue affecting SSO provisioning for a subset of users. Our engineers are triaging now and we can offer a manual provisioning flow to unblock affected users immediately.
Next update: ~3 hours. Final resolution: targeted within 24 hours.
If you have a priority user, please reply with the email and we’ll provision them manually right away.
Thanks,
Emily (CS)
```

Jai (Solutions Eng): Quick note on approach — if aud mismatch, temporary mitigation is to accept legacy audience header for provisioning requests while we patch the validation logic. I'll create a safe toggle with audit logs to revert. Planning to push a canary to staging in ~2h and to prod by EOD after smoke tests.

Anna (CS): Good. Emily — once you send the one-pager, add the manual provisioning play link and offer a 30m walkthrough slot tomorrow morning. Also file a renewal-risk note in the account record: "Onboarding friction; CS enabling; eng patching; renewal in 6w."

Mike (Support): DMed the impacted user list and a sample session_id per user. OpsBot: INC-7890 updated to state "CS engaged; SE triage in progress"

OpsBot: Incident INC-7890 | Priority: P1 -> P0 (escalated) | Owners: Jai (SE), Emily (CS) | Status: triage in progress | https://redwood.incidents/INC-7890

Anna (CS): Thanks team. Emily — please post the customer email thread link here once sent. Jai — ping when you have the staging canary. I'll draft the renewal watch note after Emily sends comms. :closed_lock_with_key:
